meta_description: Top Reasons to Book this Lovely Home:* 6-Seater Golf Cart Available ($500 refundable deposit required.)* Private Covered Balconies* 4 Complimentary Bikes* 880yds to Gulf View Heights Access* Updated Community Pool Area* Community Covered Grill Area and
description_expanded: Top Reasons to Book this Lovely Home:* 6-Seater Golf Cart Available ($500 refundable deposit required.)* Private Covered Balconies* 4 Complimentary Bikes* 880yds to Gulf View Heights Access* Updated Community Pool Area* Community Covered Grill Area and Fire Pit* Quiet Neighborhood with Updated Landscaping* Snorkel the Sea Turtle Reef-more info under Area Attractions below* Professionally Managed; 24/7 Service*This property is not available to adults under age 25. No Exceptions.*Stargaze is a peaceful and luxurious 4 bedroom, 3.5 bath home located in the gated Starview Terrace community, just off scenic 30A. This gorgeous home includes a golf cart and 4 bikes for ease and convenience. The upscale interior features an open floor plan, covered balconies, and an all-suite bedroom layout. The 2nd floor features a spacious living space and a dining area that seats 8 people. There is additional seating in the gourmet kitchen highlighted by a waterfall island that has a built-in gas range and stainless-steel appliances. The first master suite is located on the 1st floor and features a King Bed. The 3rd floor of the home features a master suite boasting a King bed, a third bedroom with a Queen bed, and the fourth bedroom with Twin over Twin bunk beds and Full over Full bunk beds, allowing this home to sleep 12 guests comfortably. Hop on the golf cart and head to the beach or take a stroll to the community pool. Come see why Stargaze is the vacation home of your dreams!Starview Terrace is a small, gated community located just off Scenic Highway 30A. Secluded by palm trees this area gains a private feel that extends to the updated community amenities, which include a wood-burning fire pit, a covered grill area, a sundeck, and an all-season outdoor pool (not heated). You will find the beach access a short distance away at the Gulfview Heights Access, which includes parking, restrooms, showers, covered picnic tables, and lifeguards (during peak season).*There is only parking for 2 vehicles in the driveway and 1 in the garage. There is no overflow parking available in this community. *Bed Setup:1st Floor:Master Suite: King Bed3rd Floor:Master Suite: King BedGuest Room: Queen Bed Bunk Room: 2 Twin-over-Twin bunkbeds + 2 Full-over-Full bunkbedsArea Attractions:This is a fantastic location with Gulf Place Town Center only 1 mile to the West and Watercolor, Grayton Beach, Seaside, Seacrest and Rosemary Beach just minutes away to the East. Biking is a great activity to enjoy as the scenic bike path meanders along 30A. Bike over to Blue Mountain Beach Creamery for some homemade scoops that will have your taste buds coming back! You'll have an array of dining options to choose from! 30A is a fantastic destination, the beaches are some of the world’s best with sugar white sand and emerald green waters. You will find plenty of beach accesses along a 17 mile stretch of Santa Rosa Beach. It boasts unique shopping, fantastic cuisine and the incredible architecture that makes 30A famous, there are activities for everyone; kayak rentals, bike rentals, paragliding, fishing, golfing, hiking, swimming, tennis - you'll find it all right here.The snorkelers in your group will love the new artificial reef called Sea Turtle Reef, deployed in 2017. Located just 783 feet out from the Grayton Beach State Park access, it is becoming a haven for sea life. Each of the 4 snorkeling reefs comprises 40 acres of permitted sea bottom. The Sea Turtle Reef is at a depth of 12-19 feet. We strongly recommend that snorkelers use a kayak, paddleboard, or other flotation device when visiting the snorkel reefs. Sea conditions can and do change quickly and often. Enjoy! Read less
